page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Large heading at top, then author line, short Latin title lines in the middle, a line of Scripture-style text, two woodcut or printer's ornaments in the middle, and the imprint at the foot. Several lines are rotated or show-through and are only partly legible.
page.notes: Title page only. The upper title lines are blurred and partly cut off at the top edge. The middle block (roughly four lines of Latin, set in the centre) is rotated and has show-through. The imprint at the foot is upside down and too faint to read with confidence. Two ornaments (a printer's mark or woodcut device on the left and a coat-of-arms or cartouche on the right) sit between the middle text and the imprint and carry no text. Words are not guessed; each unread line is marked illegible. The single small mark to the right of the cartouche is not printed text. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
